Hon’ble Ashish Naithani, J.
Mr. Mani Kumar, learned counsel for the 
Applicant. 
2. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned Deputy 
Advocate General assisted by Mr. Vikas Uniyal, 
learned Brief Holder for the State.
3. Present bail application is moved by the 
applicant, who is in judicial custody in 
connection with FIR No.331 of 2025 under 
Section 64(1), 137 (2) & 144 of Bhartiya Nyaya 
Sanhita alongwith Section 3 & 4 of the 
Protection of Children from Sexual Offence and 
Section 3(2) (v)(a) of the Scheduled Castes and 
Scheduled Tribes (Prevention of Atrocities) Act 
registered at P.S.-Kunda, District Udham Singh 
Nagar. 
4. Learned counsel for the applicant submits 
that applicant has falsely been implicated in the 
commission of crime; he is never involved in 
any criminal case as he is a law abiding citizen. 
He submits that co-accused Naeem has been 
release on bail by this Court vide order date 
12.05.2026 and on the ground of parity applicant 
is also entitled to be released on bail.
5. Learned State Counsel concedes the fact 
of parity. 
6. Having heard learned counsel for the 
parties and considering the overall facts and 
circumstances of the case, this Court is of the 
view that applicant is entitled to be released on 
bail. 
7. Accordingly, bail application is allowed. Let 
the applicant-Asgar @ Nanhe be released on  bail on his executing a personal bond and two 
reliable sureties of the like amount to the 
satisfaction of the court concerned.
8. Pending application, if any, stands 
disposed of. 
 (Ashish Naithani, J.) 
 21.05.2026
